crossRefs.note: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.
In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came…
Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy…
Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel; that so you may keep the law of…
Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people…
yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings, and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge…
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…

translations.web: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.
translations.bsb: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
translations.kjv: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
translations.asv: TAV. Let my cry come near before thee, O Jehovah: Give me understanding according to thy word.
